description: This is a PHP source file defining the Api class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.User namespace. The class provides methods for managing API entities, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving APIs, as well as managing associated IP addresses and sessions.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A class for managing API credentials, IPs, and sessions for users in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addApi
methods.description: Inserts a new API record into the database with provided data, including optional API IP addresses.

methods.name: editApi
methods.description: Updates an existing API record identified by $api_id with new data and associated IP addresses.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes an API record from the database based on the provided $api_id.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Fetches a single API record by its $api_id.

methods.name: getApis
methods.description: Retrieves a list of APIs from the database, optionally sorted and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalApis
methods.description: Returns the total count of API records in the database.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Associates an IP address with an API by inserting into the api_ip table.

methods.name: deleteIp
methods.description: Removes all IP addresses associated with a given API.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a specific API.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Creates a new session for an API with a session ID and IP address.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves all sessions for a specific API.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session by its session ID.

methods.name: deleteSessionsBySessionId
methods.description: Deletes sessions associated with a specific session ID string.
